notes: Version 2.29.0 brings everything that has been running in the beta. The engineer now talks to you like a person: small talk, jokes and questions about racing or anything else get a real answer in his personality instead of 'focus on your driving', and a question like 'should I put ABS on 3?' is answered as advice instead of changing the car. The track map can be rotated and mirrored per track, and you can mark your own corners and points of interest on it, name them, rename or delete them - the engineer then says your name for the corner, with the rest of the sentence in your language. Corners no longer go missing: short corners on laps recorded by older versions now show up in lap history, a corner right at the end of the lap is no longer dropped, and corner numbers stay on the map even where the map has a gap. Game sound: the microphone can no longer stay open forever, a Bluetooth headset microphone is no longer tried automatically (it switched headsets into call mode and muted the game), your microphone choice is remembered by name, and the update window no longer pops up over a running game. Assetto Corsa: PitWise wrote wrong keys into controls.ini (Escape raised ABS, Enter TC, arrows changed brake bias) - it now uses the correct keys and repairs the old entries itself. The 'Error creating window handle' crash at startup with a wheel or pedals plugged in is fixed. The engineer no longer announces your position every few seconds when cars swap places, and there is a switch for position calls. Voice volume goes up to 200 percent (a few dB louder, not double). In Le Mans Ultimate qualifying with ghosted cars the spotter stays quiet, and calls about cars around you are always spoken instantly. The list of questions after an answer is optional, the engineer tells you when the AI cannot be reached, and questions are no longer mistaken for pit commands. Le Mans Ultimate and rF2 track maps recorded by older versions are drawn again once. The weather improvements from 2.28.6 are included. The iRacing track map is still being tested in the beta and stays off here for now.
